name: AdCP 3.2 Signature header declares label 'sig1' twice (malformed structured dictionary, content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #verifier-checklist-requests step 1 (RFC 9421 §4.2 Signature is a Dictionary; RFC 8941 §3.2 keys are unique; AdCP rejects duplicate labels rather than retaining the last); AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/029-duplicate-signature-label.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. Signature-Input carries sig1 exactly once, covers content-digest, and is well formed; only the Signature header repeats the label. Both Signature members are the same valid Ed25519 signature over expected_signature_base, so a verifier that keeps either one verifies it and the repeated label is the only fault. Generated by scripts/generate-request-signing-profile-3.2-vectors.mjs from the test keys in keys.json; do not hand-edit.
